_status_notes.NOT_QUALIFIED: Score-bucket outcome (scripts/score_job.py) for an eligible-but-below-threshold or hard-rejected job. Added in Phase 7.2, replacing this path's prior (ambiguous) use of REJECTED going forward.
_status_notes.REJECTED: LEGACY value. Before Phase 7.2, scripts/score_job.py used this literal string for the same score-bucket outcome NOT_QUALIFIED now represents. Kept in this list ONLY for backward compatibility with existing rows written before that change -- no code writes this value anymore. Never assume a row with this status was rejected by an employer.
_status_notes.EMPLOYER_REJECTED: Reserved for a genuine, human-recorded employer/application-lifecycle rejection, once an approval/application workflow exists to set it. No code in this project currently writes this value -- see data/reports/phase7_2_automation_status_audit.md.
